summary: Your sixth teach-back. You answer a colleague who thinks a good prompt is enough, explain why model output must be validated with two concrete failures, check six key points, and run six realistic replies through your validation to see five rejected and one that passes while being wrong.
goal: Explain in 5 sentences why model output must be validated, with concrete failures and the one a schema cannot catch.

items.text: Write what you would answer the colleague and one thing that could still go wrong
Explain why output must be validated, with two concrete failures, in 5 sentences or a 60-second voice note
Tick the six key points your explanation said clearly and count them
Run validation_gap.py and see five rejected and one valid-but-wrong reply
Write a better sentence for the biggest gap and add the valid-but-wrong case
Play the Output Skeptic game to the end and see your score
